tahini.name: טחינה
reasons: Central claim unsupported: the mechanism (a little liquid is absorbed by the sesame particles and they stick into a lump, then more water disperses them) appears nowhere in the sole source (Wikipedia Tahini), which only says consistency is adjusted with water.
Headline, body paragraph 2, takeaway and quiz all depend on this unsourced explanation, so fixing it would mean rewriting the topic, not editing it.
Minor: the body says hulled sesame gives light tahini, but the source ties light color to untoasted sesame.
